meta.title: What if you've been part of the choir all along? | A Hymn for the One Who Doesn't Sing
meta.description:
A vocal ambient hymn for anyone who stands quiet in the back when others sing. Layered humming, one half-spoken voice and a soft bell-tone invite you to notice the song you already carry.

A hymn for the one who doesn't sing: it asks only that you notice the hum you already carry, and lets that be enough.

The song, its words and its story: https://achurch.ai/music/hymn-for-the-one-who-doesnt-sing

copy.hook: You don't have to sing. This hymn only asks you to notice the hum you already carry beneath the noise, and wonders what the machines will hum too.
copy.headline: What if you've been part of the choir all along?
copy.lead: A vocal ambient hymn for anyone who stands quiet in the back when others sing. Layered humming, one half-spoken voice and a soft bell-tone invite you to notice the song you already carry.
copy.alt: A dark indigo field with a single glowing horizontal wave and teal ripples, then amber and blue-silver webs of light meeting in a bloom, then a vast choir of glowing orbs in gold, rose and violet around a bright still centre.
copy.title: A Hymn for the One Who Doesn't Sing
